mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_uid, receiver_uid, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{senderUid}, #{receiverUid}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE (sender_uid = #{uid1} AND receiver_uid = #{uid2}) OR (sender_uid = #{uid2} AND receiver_uid = #{uid1}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE sender_uid = #{senderUid} AND receiver_uid = #{receiverUid} AND is_read = 0
